caption: The chapter's worked example in order: GET /items/7?expand=price gets 200 OK with an 84-byte body, POST /items gets 201 Created, DELETE /items/7 gets 204 No Content with 0 bytes. Notice all three codes are 2xx success, and only 204 forbids a body.

spec.aria: A client sends GET /items/7?expand=price and gets 200 OK with an 84-byte body, sends POST /items and gets 201 Created with a Location header, then sends DELETE /items/7 and gets 204 No Content with a 0-byte body.
